name: clef-loop
description: Capture opted-in, redacted, human- or validator-labeled decisions, build Clef and Workers AI LoRA datasets, evaluate base vs tuned vs frontier with calibration, tune Clef-flash, and canary the tune on Cloudflare with fallback and a validator-driven revert.
author: Jacob Lopez

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p validator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p repros/tsconfig.json
scripts.demo: node src/cli.ts build --csv fixtures/leads.csv --questions fixtures/questions.json --names fixtures/names.txt --heldout 60 --out data/demo && node src/cli.ts eval --heldout data/demo/clef/heldout.jsonl --train data/demo/clef/train.jsonl --arm logged=replay --arm majority=majority --run-id synthetic-demo --note "Synthetic data: these numbers test the pipeline, not any model." --out out/demo
